_about: Quote amendments applied on top of census-repartitioned.json by normalize.py and check_sources.py. The census files are never edited; when a manuscript sentence a claim quotes is changed, the new wording and the reason go here. Since 2026-09-17 an entry may also restate the claim (expression, construction, status keys, each recorded beside its *_previous value) or withdraw it (withdrawn: true) when the restated sentence no longer makes the censused claim.
